title: Detailed lightning bolt
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bolt' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fffde0'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#ffe94a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb200'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='edge' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd23a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff8a00'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft glow behind the bolt -->
  <polygon points='58,4 26,54 46,54 38,96 76,42 54,42 66,4'
           fill='#ffd84d' opacity='0.28'/>

  <!-- main bolt body -->
  <polygon points='58,6 28,52 47,52 39,94 74,44 54,44 64,6'
           fill='url(#bolt)'
           stroke='url(#edge)' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- inner highlight streak for detail -->
  <polygon points='56,14 36,48 46,48 42,72 62,44 52,44 58,14'
           fill='#fffceb' opacity='0.75'/>

  <!-- bright core spark at the top -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='9' r='3.2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- small spark near the tip -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='88' r='2.4' fill='#fff3b0'/>

  <!-- little electric arcs -->
  <path d='M30 60 l-9 4 l6 3' fill='none' stroke='#ffd23a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M72 50 l9 -4 l-6 -3' fill='none' stroke='#ffd23a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M66 76 l7 6 l-5 2' fill='none' stroke='#ffb200' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
